skills.skill_desc:
Rafaela can cast a special skill every 10s. After channeling for 2.5s, she instantly resurrects an ally and increases their Movement Speed by 30% for 5s (taking damage from heroes and Legend Creeps interrupts channeling and puts the skill on base cooldown).
This skill's cooldown is increased by 600% of the target's remaining respawn time, capped at 240s. This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

Rafaela strikes the three nearest enemies with <font color="a6aafb">Light of Retribution</font>, dealing them 350<font color="62f8fe"> (+120% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>, briefly revealing their positions, and slowing them by 40% for 1.5s. Enemies hit by <font color="a6aafb">Light of Retribution</font> again within 6s will take 20% extra damage (this effect stacks up to 3 times).

Rafaela calls upon Holy Light, recovering 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+35% Total Magic Power)</font> HP to nearby allied heroes, plus an additional 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+65% Total Magic Power)</font> HP to herself and the most injured allied hero in range. She also increases the Movement Speed of nearby allied heroes by 30% and grants Slow Immunity for 1s.
Every 10 <font color="62f8fe"><1030></font> increases the Movement Speed bonus by 1%.

Rafaela unleashes the true power of <font color="a6aafb">Holy Light</font> in the target direction, dealing 460<font color="62f8fe"> (+120% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in a line and stunning them for 1.2s.
